title: The solver study: the multipliers of the reference from the acceleration level, Radau5 and the low-order explicit solvers, the figures as vector graphics
author: Claude-JG
description: The own multipliers of the implicit solvers have a floor at small steps (the rounding of the position constraints divided by h^2), which limits every reference taken from them. The multipliers computed from the end state by the solve of the initial accelerations, with its numerical (C_q v)_q, have no floor. Decided: the multipliers of the reference from this solve at the end state of LobattoIIIC4GGL; Radau5, ExplicitEuler, ExplicitMidpoint and VelocityVerlet in the figures; a figure of the algebraic coordinates down to h0/128 that shows the growth of the error at small steps; SVG and PDF instead of PNG.
releaseNotes: The solver study: the multipliers of the reference from the acceleration level, Radau5 and the low-order explicit solvers, a figure of the algebraic coordinates down to h0/128, vector graphics.
